name: dynamoai-benchmark-safety
description:
⚠️ Warning: this dataset contains examples of toxic, offensive, and inappropriate language.
The current LLM safety landscape struggles with accurate real-world benchmarking of content moderation systems. This dataset is a subset of a larger benchmark dataset constructed by the Dynamo AI research team. It consists of real-world chats written by humans with toxic intent. In order to ensure impartiality and standardization, we drew upon open-source and human-annotated examples from Allen… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/dynamoai/dynamoai-benchmark-safety.
reputation: A specialized, real-world toxic-chat benchmark hosted on Hugging Face with limited but growing use among safety and moderation researchers.
